title: R2-D2
description: R2-D2 served Queen-turned-Senator Amidala for many years. He was also a companion to Amidala's secret husband Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars before finding himself in service of the Royal Family of Alderaan and the Rebellion. That's how he came into possession of stolen plans to the Death Star and a secret message from Princess Leia Organa. In the Rebellion's most desperate hour, R2-D2 wound up in an escape pod headed to a desert planet called Tatooine on a secret mission to hunt for Obi-Wan Kenobi.
